author: TeIq
content: **Pre-flight (architect, rust-quality applied).** Two sub-deliverables: (1) Extend audit::log::VerifyError::Tampered to carry the exact field that mismatched (prev_hash | payload | ts | actor | kind | this_hash) — the verifier already recomputes each part; just surface which step failed. (2) New #[ignore]-by-default perf test in audit_chain.rs that inserts 100k events and asserts verify_chain completes in < 30s. Both small extensions; no schema change.
